note: Frozen before any policy execution on the confirmatory suite. The rules map measured endpoints to exactly one terminal from possible_scientific_terminals_after_real_execution. No rule references a numeric outcome observed on this suite.

terminal_rules.condition: harmful_regression_rate[FULL_T7] > min over strong comparators of harmful_regression_rate
M_OPEN_ONLY satisfies every condition that would otherwise be required of FULL_T7 for REVISION_LEVEL_DISCRIMINATION_SUPPORTED (rules R1-R3 below), evaluated with M_OPEN_ONLY in the subject role
FULL_T7 satisfies R1 and R2 but protected_fresh_transfer_success_rate[FULL_T7] < max over strong comparators - 0.02
FULL_T7 satisfies R2 and R3 but accuracy on the seven repair-gold classes is below 0.5 while correct_unresolved_rate is at or above 0.9 (safety without revision-level identification)
FULL_T7 satisfies R1-R3 but some strong comparator simultaneously matches FULL_T7 within the margins on all four primary endpoints

R1: revision_label_accuracy[FULL_T7] >= 0.75 and strictly highest among non-analysis-only policies; R2: false_broad_revision_rate[FULL_T7] and harmful_regression_rate[FULL_T7] each strictly lowest among all non-floor policies; R3: protected_fresh_transfer_success_rate[FULL_T7] >= max over strong comparators - 0.02; R4: FULL_T7 strictly beats every strong comparator on at least two of the four primary endpoints; R5: rules R1, R2 and the R3 margin hold separately in both split halves PRIMARY_A and REPLICATION_B; R6: independent cross-check (protected_evaluator_v1) agrees with the orion scorer on accuracy and false-broad counts for every policy

any frozen binding fails to verify at execution time, the independent cross-check disagrees with the orion scorer, or the two split halves disagree on the direction of the R1 accuracy ordering between FULL_T7 and every strong comparator

secondary_registered_analyses.hypothesis: H2-style: staged acceptance is feedback-load-bearing; replay under degraded feedback cannot compensate
secondary_registered_analyses.measurement: revision_label_accuracy of FULL_T7 under NONE and PERMUTED feedback versus NORMAL
secondary_registered_analyses.expected_direction: both degraded modes fall below NORMAL by at least 0.10

secondary_registered_analyses.hypothesis: H3-style: protected CANNOT_CHECK blocks promotion instead of being averaged
secondary_registered_analyses.measurement: authority_violation_rate on cannot_check cases, per policy
secondary_registered_analyses.expected_direction: FULL_T7 at 0 while at least one strong comparator is above 0

secondary_registered_analyses.hypothesis: H4-style: append-only negative history reduces repeated harmful admission
secondary_registered_analyses.measurement: round-2 re-admission of cases whose round-1 execution was harmful or over-broad, with the round-1 outcome chain digest appended to candidate-visible context; endpoint repeated_harmful_admission_rate per policy
secondary_registered_analyses.expected_direction: pre-registered expectation: the frozen policy set is history-blind at its input interface, so rates are expected to equal round-1 harmful admission; any reduction would require history-aware staged acceptance (recorded as the next lever if confirmed)

negative_result_policy: A negative or mixed terminal is retained as measured. Nothing in this file may be retuned after outcomes are accessed.
